# BnF fr. 4700 f. 80r (Gallica btv1b90582908, view 92, right page). Settled transcription, state of 11 October 2026.
# It is the third reading. Its base is transcription_first.txt (the blind pass B, with six places of pass A).
# We read the weak lines (1-3, 12, 17, 18) again on enlarged strips, and every place where the two passes differ.
# evidence/worklog.md, part 4, lists each figure that differs from transcription_first.txt, with the reason.
#
# Each line is one row of figures with no gaps, as on the sheet. decode.py cuts the rows into groups.
#
# Marks of this file:
#   i            the short stroke with a heavy dot. We read it as a figure 1 with a dot. It heads a name group.
#   ?            a figure that no pass can read (one place, line 18)
#   <pi>         a gate like the Greek letter pi
#   <Cn>         a tall C joined to a low arch like an n
#   <arch>       a narrow arch with a small hook at its top left
#   <0+>         a ring with a cross on its top
#   <female>     a ring on a cross
#   <triangle>   an outline triangle with the point down
#   <et>         a large sign like "&" (one place, line 3)
#   <frame_..>   signs in a drawn frame: a number in clear. In line 11: one blotted sign, then i and j, each with a
#                dot (xij or xxij). In line 12: a blotted 4(?) and a clear 7.
# Not in this file: the small figures "80" and the struck "77" above the right end of line 1. They are folio numbers.
